description: This Java class 'FeatureModifiedStrategy' defines a strategy to handle 'FeatureModified' events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract event strategy and applies changes to a ThingBuilder object when such an event occurs.

classes.name: FeatureModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that processes 'FeatureModified' events to update a 'Thing' object.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle 'FeatureModified' events, setting the feature in the 'ThingBuilder' accordingly.
